name: Shopify Gallery vs Sheet Check (read only)

parameters.content:
## Shopify gallery vs sheet check (READ ONLY)

Compares, for every product, the photos on the website with the IMAGE URL1 to IMAGE URL11 links in the sheet, matched by exact file name (the `v=` cache part is ignored). It changes NOTHING: no Shopify call that writes, no sheet write.

Settings: `sheets` (blank = all tabs, or e.g. Bathtub,Stairs).

Report (last node): per tab how many products were checked and how many match, with each difference sorted into a category: cad_missing (only the CAD drawing is missing), copies_only (same pictures but Shopify holds _uuid copies), order_only, and check (wrong, missing or extra files: needs a person). Only the 'check' products are listed.

All tabs take roughly 15 to 20 minutes (Shopify rate limit). Start with one tab.

parameters.jsCode:
const j = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { kind: 'summary', tab: j.tab, ...j.stats, checked: 0, ok: 0, mismatched: 0 } }];
